name: Flat fish
summary: Flat vector fish generator: torpedo, round, tall, eel or catfish bodies; fork, fan or crescent tails; swim poses.

params.name: x
params.note: body centre x

params.name: y
params.note: body centre y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; sizes below are px at s = 1

params.name: pose
params.note: swim = body wave and tail beat from p.f; idle = slow hover, fins flutter; dart = fast beat; puffed = inflated pufferfish, no wave

params.name: len
params.note: body length nose to tail base, px; overall length is about len + 0.6 x tailSize

params.name: bodyH
params.note: body height px (default 0.55 x len; 0.9 x len when puffed)

params.name: shape
params.note: torpedo = fast swimmer; oval; round = goldfish; tall = angelfish disc; long = eel-ish slim; flat-top = catfish

params.name: head
params.note: hammer = hammerhead bar; bill = swordfish sword; whiskers = catfish barbels

params.name: color
params.note: body colour

params.name: belly
params.note: lower colour, or none

params.name: back
params.note: darker top colour, or none

params.name: finColor
params.note: fins and tail; far fins get one darker shade

params.name: tail
params.note: double = flowing goldfish tail; crescent = shark tail

params.name: tailSize
params.note: tail height px; tail length is 0.6 x tailSize

params.name: dorsal
params.note: tall = shark triangle; long = runs along the back; sail = rounded sail

params.name: pattern
params.note: bands = vertical bands (bandColor, bandEdge)

params.name: patternColor
params.note: colour of stripes, spots, speckles and scales

params.name: bandColor
params.note: fill of vertical bands

params.name: bandEdge
params.note: dark edge on each side of a band

params.name: spikes
params.note: spines around the body (pufferfish)

params.name: eyeSize
params.note: eye size multiplier

params.name: eyeType
params.note: eye = white with pupil and highlight; dot = plain dark dot

params.name: mouth
params.note: open = round bubble mouth

params.name: gills
params.note: gill slits behind the eye

params.name: bubbles
params.note: bubbles rising from the mouth, from p.f

params.name: flip
params.note: face left

params.name: vx
params.note: px per frame

author: krakujs
